title: Crowns of Sorcery
notes: Every Mage Crown can now be grown in the Tree of Life: 25 new ones across the eight schools and Wild Magic.

Pyromancy: Phoenix (once per Ascension, rise in flame instead of dying) and Living Flame (fire orbs circle you). Cryomancy: Absolute Zero, Crown of Spears and Eternal Winter. Stormcalling: Eye of the Storm, Ride the Lightning and The Storm King's Stroke.

Arcane: Timeweaver (your last 3 spells again, free) and Singularity. Tidecalling: Leviathan, Tsunami and Drowned World. Windweaving: Eye of the Hurricane (enemy shots are blown away), Skyborne and Thousand Blades.

Lightbinding: Celestial Lance, Dawnbringer (a little sun follows you) and Martyr's Prism. Voidcalling: Event Horizon, Kryuleiza's Gate and Hollow Self. Wild Magic: Chaos Engine, Pandemonium and Wheel of Fortune.
